segments.title: AI found 303 hidden Nazca lines
segments.say: AI helped find three hundred and three new Nazca drawings in the desert. In just six months.

segments.title: A 70% jump
segments.say: Before this, about four hundred thirty were known. That's a jump of around seventy percent.

segments.title: How the AI helped
segments.say: An IBM AI model flagged likely spots, and researchers checked them on foot.

segments.title: Little 'billboards' by trails
segments.say: The smaller ones show people and farm animals, placed beside walking trails.

segments.title: 968 spots still unchecked
segments.say: And nine hundred sixty eight flagged spots haven't been checked yet.
